findings: SNL131 explicitly identifies M386 main and M387 additional transmission-frame packers as fiber, with totals six and four. Do not label them metal bearing shims or silently equate them with the poured lining.
HB209 lists main packing pieces M386 eight, additional M387 four. Main quantity conflicts with the SNL six.

Neither located source specifies thickness, exact contour or receiver assignment. The fixed bracket-to-channel gap does not by itself establish that these packers fill that interface; frame-to-hull packing is another possible interpretation.

Current inner bracket/channel gap is5.805714mm, resulting from different scaled inside/outside casting mounting planes. It is an unresolved receiver/packing issue, not a source dimension for M386 orM387.
